text.text: Under the default structure rules, full Seared Blocks such as Seared Bricks can form either the floor or walls of a smeltery. Decorative slabs, stairs and walls are not substitutes for those full blocks.

To make Seared Bricks, craft one Clay Ball, one Sand or Red Sand, and one Gravel into two Grout. Smelt each Grout in a furnace to obtain one Seared Brick, then arrange four Seared Bricks in a 2×2 square to make one Seared Bricks block.

This page shows Seared Bricks as a representative icon, not the original cycling block-tag display. Datapacks may change valid structure blocks or recipe ingredients. The recipes are implemented; actual crafting, building, save/reload and LAN remain unverified.
